svg.aria-label: Anatomy of a make.fun guide submission
svg.text: Anatomy of one submission: a public GitHub repository + its transcript bundle
github.com/<owner>/<repo> — public, created after the bounty opens, MIT licensed
README.md — the guide itself, at the root, exact name
3 live make.fun badges on top · your referral code named · at most 2 MB · no .github/README.md shadowing it
screenshot.png — your real repository page on GitHub, README showing
PNG / JPEG / WebP · at most 8 MB and 16,000,000 pixels · top square shows the repo name + guide start
About block: website = the bounty page on make.fun · topics include makefun
The recorded sessions that wrote the guide,
plus the run record: prompt, harness, model,
effort, system prompt, instruction files, MCP servers.
≥ 30% of counted lines authored by the agent ·
≥ 1 file revised in ≥ 2 messages · ≥ 5 text turns ·
all timestamps inside the competition window.
